itemized.notes: April 5, 2012 interim (that box is checked; amendment = No). The whole Complete Mailing Address column on Schedule A is covered by a solid black REDACTION BOX applied by the county (the filename itself says _Redacted), and the cover's address/phone/fax fields are blacked out too - so donor_city/donor_state are blank because the geography was REDACTED, not because the filer left it empty. Amounts on both schedules write cents as a superscript over a rule. Schedule A line 7 is not a donor at all but the filer's AGGREGATE line, 'Aggregate of cash contributions $50. or less' for the date range 3/14-31/12 - kept verbatim as its own row because the form itemizes it as one, with a blank date. Five Schedule B rows and that aggregate row carry DATE RANGES, which are left blank per contract. Schedule A rows 1-6 use a two-digit year (3-30-12); rows 8-13 use the four-digit form; both parse to 2012.
